types.name: BackerRecord
docs: One backer. PDA `[SEED_BACKER, pool, backer]`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Matured money.

fields.name: withdraw_amount
docs: Open withdrawal request (0 = none). Still counts toward capacity until completed.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields a later upgrade adds.

types.name: Claim
docs: One claim. PDA `[SEED_CLAIM, pool, staker, tx_hash]`: the address is the claim id.

fields.name: stake
docs: Stake principal behind the claim (restored to `total_staked` by a cancel).

fields.name: capacity_snapshot
docs: Capacity just before this claim's forfeiture: the floor of its daily payout base.

fields.name: approve_window
docs: Approve window this claim was admitted with (the setting at admission).

fields.name: inactivity_window
docs: Inactivity window this claim started paying with (the setting at approval).

fields.name: pause_mark
docs: Paused total (`Pool::paused_secs_at`) when the claim's current window started: the hack
window while queued, the approve window, then the collection window. Pause time after it
does not count against the window.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields a later upgrade adds.

types.name: ClaimApproval
docs: What the oracle attests. The program never reads a price: the oracle converts the loss to
lamports off-chain and the program bounds it by the tier ceiling.

fields.name: tx_hash
docs: Hash of the drain transaction (any chain), as the claim id's second half.

fields.name: entitlement
docs: Lamports.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix seconds; the approval must land by then.

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Claim lifecycle (multichain `ClaimStatus`). `Unused` is the zero value of a fresh account (an
override approval can create the account before the claim exists).

types.name: CoveredWallet
docs: One covered wallet, bound to one staker forever. PDA `[SEED_COVERED, pool, wallet_hash]`.
`wallet_hash = sha256(chain_id || normalized address)`, computed by the backend.

types.name: DeployBelowFloor
docs: mSOL received below the expected amount by more than the rebalance limit (multichain `PushBelowFloor`).

types.name: DeploymentLoss
docs: The pool's part of an unstake fee above the growth that came back: marked off `total_staked`
(multichain `DeploymentShortfall`).

fields.name: remaining
docs: Principal left in the stake (0 = fully withdrawn, record closed).

types.name: OverrideRequest
docs: 2-of-2 override request (admin + co-signer). PDA `[SEED_OVERRIDE, claim]`. Deleted on execution.

fields.name: admin_approver
docs: The approving keys, not flags: a rotated role's old approval no longer counts.

types.name: PendingSetting
docs: A setting change on its way: proposed by the admin, approved by the co-signer (starting the
timelock), executed by anyone after `eta`.

fields.name: eta
docs: Earliest execution; 0 until approved.

fields.name: state
docs: 0 none, 1 proposed, 2 approved.

types.name: Pool
docs: The one pool. PDA `[SEED_POOL]`. Holds roles, Marinade addresses, settings, totals, yield books
and the current day's counters (only today is ever read).

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: What the pool holds and pays in. The native SOL mint today; a later upgrade can move the
pool to another asset (e.g. USDC) and migrate, without a new pool.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Signs `submit_claim` and the Ed25519 approval in front of it.

fields.name: registry_writer
docs: Backend key that registers covered wallets after an off-chain ownership proof.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives protocol revenue (`withdraw_yield`).

fields.name: pool_msol
docs: The pool's mSOL token account, owned by the vault PDA.

fields.name: cluster
docs: Fixed at `initialize`, signed into every oracle approval.

fields.name: settings
docs: Every adjustable number, one slot per `pool_core::settings::SettingKey`. Read only through
[`Pool::settings`]. Unused slots are room for settings an upgrade adds.

fields.name: paused_until
docs: Unix seconds; paused while `now < paused_until`. After `unpause` it holds the moment the
pause ended, so it is always the end of the last pause (0 = never paused).

fields.name: pause_started_at
docs: Start of the last pause (0 = never paused).

fields.name: paused_before
docs: Seconds paused in every pause before the last one. With the two above, the pause clock that
stops claim windows during a pause.

fields.name: total_backed
docs: Matured backer money: counts toward capacity.

fields.name: total_backed_pending
docs: Backer money still maturing: held, not counted.

fields.name: total_allocated
docs: Unpaid entitlement of every admitted claim.

fields.name: staker_yield_reserved
docs: Yield owed to stakers / backers, kept liquid, never spent on claims.

fields.name: protocol_yield_balance
docs: Protocol revenue: the treasury may withdraw it; until then claims may use it.

fields.name: deployed_msol
docs: mSOL the pool holds on its books (a donation to the token account is not counted).

fields.name: deployed_book
docs: SOL cost of `deployed_msol` (book value, never marked to market).

fields.name: day
docs: Day number (`unix / SECONDS_PER_DAY`) the counters below belong to.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields a later upgrade adds.

types.name: RevokedApproval
docs: A revoked oracle approval. PDA `[SEED_REVOKED, pool, sha256(approval message)]`. Permanent.

types.name: SettingProposed
docs: Setting changes: every step is public, so stakers see a change a full timelock ahead.

types.name: StakeRecord
docs: One staker's stake. PDA `[SEED_STAKE, pool, staker]`. Closed when all of it is withdrawn (or
taken by emergency exit); a forfeited record is never closed, so that address can never stake
again.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Receives withdrawals, yield and claim payouts.

fields.name: amount
docs: Principal; a partial withdrawal lowers it (and with it the coverage ceiling). Kept (not
zeroed) when forfeited: the override path reads it.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Set when a claim on this stake is approved. Cleared only by `cancel_claim` undoing it.

fields.name: forfeited_by
docs: The claim whose approval forfeited this stake. Only that claim may re-use the forfeited
principal (a 2-of-2 override correcting it); any other claim on this stake is refused.

fields.name: suspended
docs: Admin hold on payouts. Does not block principal withdrawal.

fields.name: active_claim
docs: Claim account open on this stake (admitted, not yet terminal).

fields.name: reserved_claim
docs: Claim account queued on this stake.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields a later upgrade adds.

types.name: StakerWallets
docs: The covered wallets of one staker. PDA `[SEED_STAKER_WALLETS, pool, staker]`.

fields.name: wallet_hashes
docs: Slot 1. Fixed at one entry: the layout before the 2nd slot existed, kept in place so accounts
written by the 1-wallet build still read correctly.

fields.name: wallet_hash_2
docs: Slot 2, taken from the old `reserved` (old accounts read zeros here; `count` governs).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields a later upgrade adds.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Principal left in the stake (0 = fully withdrawn, record closed).

constants.name: YIELD_INDEX_PRECISION
docs: Clients read it from the IDL to show yield owed (`pool_core::yields::owed`).
